data.title: Marketing Maven Ranks Among Top 15 Home Furnishings PR Firms Nationally by O'Dwyer's

data.title: First Patient Dosed in Phase III Perioperative Study of Cadonilimab (PD-1/CTLA-4) in Colon Cancer
data.description: In Hong Kong on October 10, 2026, Akeso, Inc. revealed that they have dosed the initial patient in a Phase III clinical trial (COMPASSION-40/AK104-313) examining cadonilimab, their innovative PD-1/CTLA-4 bispecific antibody, as a single treatment option. The Company's stock symbol is 9926.HK.

data.title: The Next Frontier in Industrial 3D Printing: How UnionTech Integrates AI into Manufacturing Workflows
data.description: UnionTech's flagship platform, Quick AI, is revolutionizing industrial AI applications by connecting customer demand with manufacturing processes. Process engineers are creating customized "Process Agents," making the production process seamless. The development is happening in Shanghai, as of October 10, 2026. This technology is streamlining operations in producing complex parts using 3D models.

data.title: MEGAN FOX BECOMES CO-OWNER OF SUBS.COM AND LAUNCHES OFFICIAL PAGE
data.description: Actress Megan Fox has recently acquired a stake in a direct-to-fan platform, marking a new step in her career. This move allows her to have her own exclusive channel for fans, under her complete control. The announcement was made in Los Angeles on October 9, 2026. Megan's ownership in the platform signifies a trend towards celebrities taking a more active role in engaging with their fanbase. Furthermore, the platform is set to welcome additional celebrity figures in the near future, indicating a growing interest in this form of direct interaction.

data.title: Catholic Charities USA launches relief fund for those impacted by Hurricane Isaias
data.description: In Alexandria, Virginia on October 9, 2026, it has been reported that Hurricane Isaias is predicted to hit the Gulf Coast with destructive winds and hazardous storm surges. In response to this forecast, Catholic Charities USA (CCUSA), the official domestic relief agency of the Catholic Church in the U.S., has initiated efforts to address the impending crisis.

data.title: General Mills Announces Pricing Terms, Expiration and Results of Cash Tender Offers for its Senior Notes
data.description: General Mills, Inc., based in Minneapolis, has disclosed the pricing terms and outcomes of its tender offers, as well as their expiration. The company did not disclose the exact numbers, but it's a significant update for investors and stakeholders.

data.title: Blueberry Medical (“Blueberry”) Security Incident
data.description: In Mountain View, California, an unauthorized individual took advantage of a critical vulnerability in the Metabase platform on August 10 to gain administrator access to Blueberry's Metabase environment. This incident was part of a larger exploitation of the vulnerability. Blueberry discovered the unauthorized access on August 22 and promptly activated their incident-response procedures. Within about one hour of detection, they successfully stopped the unauthorized access and related sessions.

data.description: On October 9, 2026, Levi & Korsinsky, LLP released a statement addressed to individuals or entities who bought Priority Technology Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: PRTH) stock before September 18, 2026. This notice serves as a notification to all concerned parties.

data.title: Stowers scientist selected for $28.6 million research effort to predict protein changes behind neurodegenerative disease
data.description: In recent news, a team of scientists has received a new award in Kansas City, Mo., on Oct. 9, 2026. This award aims to unite experts in the fields of AI, conducting large-scale experiments, and studying human-cells to forecast detrimental alterations in proteins prior to the onset of diseases. The focus of their research will be on neurodegenerative conditions like Alzheimer's and Parkinson's. This initiative combines cutting-edge technology with comprehensive studies to anticipate protein changes and potentially intervene before the manifestation of diseases.

data.title: Alignment Healthcare Investigation Notice: SueWallSt Notifies Investors of Pending Investigation Into Alignment Healthcare (ALHC)
data.description: Following CMS's announcement of a 3.5-star 2027 rating for the Alignment Healthcare contract that encompasses over 75% of its health-plan members, two Wall Street downgrades were issued. This led to a sharp decline in ALHC's stock, which opened with a drop of approximately 20%. Additionally, an investigation has been initiated to look into possible violations of securities laws. The developments unfolded in New York on October 9, 2026.

data.title: LibertyStream Updates Shareholder Meeting Timing
data.description: Dallas-based LibertyStream Infrastructure Partners Inc. (TSXV: LIB | OTCQB: VLTLF | FSE: I2D) has decided to delay its annual and special shareholder meeting, initially set for October 15, 2026. The meeting will now take place in the latter half of November 2026, with a specific date yet to be confirmed. This postponement aims to align with upcoming business developments within the company and give shareholders ample time to review and assess these updates.
